Display Aston Machan

Most Umamusume debut out of dreams and admiration for racing itself,
or for self-fulfillment achieved through making their mark on the track.

And there, right before my eyes...
were Umamusume mascots selling like hotcakes...!

Then I shall study business! ...Hmm, not bad at all.
While concocting a strategy around that, I would also like to learn a quicker way.

Debuting purely just to get merchandise made was quite unusual.
Her real motive was also unclear.

Perhaps Ms. Chloe Harvard lives around here,
so I was introduced through her.
And with that, shall we be on our way?

With an oddly solemn expression,
Aston Machan began to speak at length.
...It seemed to be a habit of hers that her replies never quite made sense.

What started it, you ask? Well, you see... A few years ago.
Back when Machan was just a tiny bit smaller than she is now.
Shall I introduce you?

The dream is nationwide expansion, and then overseas expansion.
Right now, alongside racing, I am also studying bookkeeping. Ahem.

I see, I see.
Then it is about time you took a break.

Machan was fortunately born lovely and has remained so ever since,
so I believe everything will work out if I just debut and win.

I came across her relaxing. ...For some reason, there was
a white pigeon beside her, and she was casually chatting with it.

Oh, right! There is something I want to show you, Arimura-san.
Machan's special treasure. Would you like to see it? I see, I see.

How can I get one into everyone's hands?
Isn't there a more innovative, efficient way than handing them out directly?
A wild pigeon just hanging out next to her... Could that really be a thing?

I gathered that she enrolled here strictly to get merchandise made,
and that her passion for it was extraordinary. But—

Negative publicity! Doing bad things that stir up the tabloid talk shows!
...Rejected. I do not want to be called Aston Badchan.

Howa-howa-san, you are exceedingly fluffy.
So fluffy that I feel the fluffiness might rub off on me.

Setting aside that merchandise is rarely made before debuting...
I remembered she had mentioned becoming a "mascot" before.

A friend. Not a pet.
Though we did only just meet.

Her answer strangely made sense,
so the truth ended up remaining a mystery.

Aston Machan stated with peculiar seriousness.
The pigeon beside her cooed as if chiming in agreement.

Chloe-san, you are full of energy today as well.
How is the baby doing?

It is a top-priority mission. One Aston Machan per household.
I think it would be lovely if such an era came to pass.

Yes, Machan will never forget.
Once we meet, I will remember forever.
My special treasure.

I should have stood out super well in that mock race the other day.
The road to becoming an ultra super mascot is long.
Oh, perhaps it was Hattori Shinobimaru. Or Arimura-san?

Did she forget to explain that core part, or was she dodging the question?
There was no answer in her words. Although curious—

I was taking an afternoon nap, and when I woke up, they were sleeping next to me.
And so, we were having a chat together.

A few days after filming Aston Machan's video.
While taking a stroll under the railway overpass on my way back from shopping...

Machan does not have a mascot yet. In fact, there isn't
a single piece of merch. And I wanted to show Arimura-san...
Meooww.

A mascot loved by all...
I see, with this, if I do this... Machan can, too!
Ouch.

It was astonishing! I had no idea that mascots of
Umamusume who excelled in races were sooo popular!
Caww!

Hattori Shinobimaru~!
Ehehe, the weather is nice today, perfect for an afternoon nap.

You are a hard worker, Arimura-san.
Did you find some new food?

And so, Machan enrolled in Tracen Academy
with plans to make a big splash in the Twinkle Series!

—Appearing everywhere, held in the hands of everyone,
that kind of super, no, ultra super mascot is what I want to be!

A good method just wouldn't come to mind. Then one day—
Machan happened to visit an Umamusume merchandise shop.

Oh?
You are... the Trainer from that video the other day, aren't you?

Machan was troubled. Even though the Machan dolls were complete,
I did not know how to hand them out.

From the look of things, Aston Machan's claim
about "wanting to be a mascot" was surprisingly serious.
Machan's dream is to become a mascot.

I was to be introduced to someone.
Taken to the edge of the shopping district, what met my eyes was—

And so, with an ant balanced on one hand, our destination was...
an Umamusume merch shop in town.
